# Input

## Purpose
Reads the pointer through the Input System and announces presses, drags and releases that start on the game world - in world units - so other modules never touch raw input. Presses that start over UI are left to the UI.

## Concepts
input, pointer, mouse, touch, press, drag, release, Input System, InputSystem_Actions, Board action map
